reviewNotes: AI draft candidates only. The observed day is chosen by the user and confirmed; the planned task reference remains separate. Recording a note leaves checklist, harvest, stock and sales records unchanged. No new runtime language or human/fluent approval.

messages.english: Record your own field observations from planned tasks.

translations.zu: Rekhoda lokho okubonile ensimini yakho kusukela emisebenzini ehleliwe.
translations.st: Ngola seo o se boneng tshimong ya hao ho tswa mesebetsing e rerilweng.
translations.ts: Rekhoda leswi u swi voneke ensin’wini ya wena ku suka eka mintirho leyi kunguhatiweke.
translations.ve: Rekhodani zwe na zwi vhona tsimuni yaṋu ni tshi bva kha mishumo yo pulaniwaho.

translations.zu: Umhleli Wemisebenzi → Umsebenzi onezinsuku → Rekhoda okwenzekile
translations.st: Moralo wa Mesebetsi → Mosebetsi o nang le matsatsi → Ngola se etsahetseng
translations.ts: Mupulani wa Mintirho → Mintirho leyi nga ni masiku → Rekhoda leswi humeleleke

messages.english: Choose the day you observed something, write a note and confirm it. The journal keeps the planned reference separately; checklist, harvest, stock and sales records are unchanged.

translations.zu: Khetha usuku obone ngalo okuthile, ubhale inothi bese uliqinisekisa. Ijenali igcina ireferensi yomsebenzi ohleliwe ngokwehlukana; amarekhodi ohlu lokuhlola, okuvuniwe, isitoko nokuthengisa awashintshi.
translations.st: Kgetha letsatsi leo o boneng ho hong ka lona, ngola ntlha mme o e netefatse. Jenale e boloka tshupiso ya mosebetsi o rerilweng ka thoko; direkoto tsa lenane la ho hlahloba, kotulo, setoko le thekiso ha di fetohe.
translations.ts: Hlawula siku leri u voneke swo karhi ha rona, tsala notsi kutani u yi tiyisisa. Jenali yi hlayisa xikombo xa ntirho lowu kunguhatiweke hi ku hambana; tirhekhodo ta nxaxamelo wo kambela, ntshovelo, xitoko ni ku xavisa a ti cinci.
translations.ve: Khethani ḓuvha ḽe na vhona tshithu ngaḽo, ṅwalani notsi ni i khwaṱhisedze. Dzhenala i vhulunga ndaedzo ya mushumo wo pulaniwaho nga thungo; rekhodo dza mutevhe wa u sedzulusa, khaṋo, tshitoko na thengiso a dzi shanduki.
